dict.string: CamTrack Pro requires GPS access to capture georeferencing coordinates alongside camera positions outdoors.
CamTrack Pro requires always-on background location tracking to log GPS coordinates while the screen is off or while taking photos inside the default camera app.
CamTrack Pro requires access to your Photo Library to scan, match, and sync photos taken during the tracking session with logged coordinates.
CamTrack Pro requires camera access to activate ARKit Visual-Inertial-LiDAR Odometry for precise local metric positioning indoors.
CamTrack Pro requires access to device motion sensors (gyroscope/accelerometer) to record precise camera attitudes and orientations.
